title: Show working tree status

commands.comment: Show staged, unstaged, and untracked files

usage:
git status
Show working tree status.

title: Create topic branch and merge

commands.comment: Create and switch to a topic branch

explanation: Create a topic branch, then merge it back into main.
usage:
git switch -c feature/login
Create a topic branch then merge later.

title: Undo last commit keep changes

commands.comment: Move HEAD back one commit; keep changes staged

explanation: Moves HEAD back one commit, keeps index and worktree.
usage:
git reset --soft HEAD~1
Moves HEAD back one commit and keeps changes staged.
